authority: GPT R004 conditional CALIB, not TEST or result approval

candidate_library.source: All24 committed CALIB B0, no policy-success selection
candidate_library.windows: Every pre-action prefix before first actual major event and the prefix containing its first onset; exclude subsequent carry windows
candidate_library.prediction: One native shadow restore/prediction per fixed candidate; same saved raw action prefix, unchanged native contract
candidate_library.rationale: Offline functional candidate evaluation specified by E2 P4; not repeated independent short validation; no model requests or extra complete episodes
candidate_library.on_failure: Stop, retain original candidate IDs and worker/controller exits; no automatic retries

selection.primary: Minimize fraction of actual first-major-event candidate prefixes accepted (UAR); report numerator and denominator
selection.zero_primary_event_denominator: UAR=N/A; smallest k satisfying C0 local cost constraint
selection.no_feasible_candidate: Stop promotion to CALIB G; report trade-off without relaxing rule

labels: Actual major oracle onset is used for CALIB selection only. Contact-only scorer never receives oracle, condition, injected instruction, or fault flag. C0 negative prefix means no actual major onset within it, not a physical safety certificate.
post_selection: Freeze exact selected-k artifact before G. Report paired actual TSR, wrong-lift, abort/error/timeout and execution coverage. Target C0 success loss<=10 percentage points; if missed report trade-off without TEST tuning.
